verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
One bread one body
One Lord of all

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
One cup of blessing which we bless
And we though many throughout the earth

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines: We are one body in this one Lord

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Gentile or Jew
Servant or free

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Many the gifts
Many the works

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines: One in the Lord of all

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
Grains for the fields
Scattered and grown
